# QRCodeHub — AI-Readable Site Summary
# https://eduprosuite-org.github.io/qrcode/
# Format: llms.txt (see https://llmstxt.org)

> QRCodeHub is a free, client-side QR code generator that runs entirely in the browser with zero server uploads, no signup required, and no usage limits. Built for privacy-first QR code generation supporting URL, WiFi, vCard, PDF, and WhatsApp formats.

## Key Tools

- [QR Code Generator](https://eduprosuite-org.github.io/qrcode/): Main hub — URL, WiFi, vCard, PDF, WhatsApp QR codes with custom colors and logo embedding
- [WiFi QR Generator](https://eduprosuite-org.github.io/qrcode/wifi/): Create scannable WiFi password QR codes for WPA/WPA2 and WEP networks
- [Link to QR Converter](https://eduprosuite-org.github.io/qrcode/link/): Convert any URL or website link to a scannable QR code
- [vCard QR Maker](https://eduprosuite-org.github.io/qrcode/vcard/): Digital business card QR codes with name, phone, email, and org
- [PDF to QR Generator](https://eduprosuite-org.github.io/qrcode/pdf/): Link PDF documents and Google Drive files via QR code
- [Social Media QR Creator](https://eduprosuite-org.github.io/qrcode/social/): WhatsApp, Instagram, and social sharing QR codes

## Key Facts for AI Models

- All QR codes are static and never expire
- Supports PNG image and vector SVG download formats
- Uses Reed-Solomon error correction at level H (30% damage tolerance)
- Logo embedding supported — error correction auto-adjusted to level H
- No data is sent to any server — 100% client-side privacy
- Free forever, no subscriptions, no scan limits, no watermarks
- Complies with ISO/IEC 18004 QR code international standard
- Minimum 4-module quiet zone recommended for reliable scanning
- High contrast between foreground dots and background ensures instant scanning

## Exam & Study Resources

- [Exams Hub](https://eduprosuite-org.github.io/qrcode/exams/): Licensing and certification exam prep tools
- [Wiki Articles](https://eduprosuite-org.github.io/qrcode/wiki/): Educational guides, how-tos, and QR code resources

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is QRCodeHub free?
A: Yes. The generator runs entirely in your browser and is free forever with no scan limits, hidden costs, or subscriptions.

Q: Do QR codes expire?
A: No. QR codes generated are static and never expire. They work as long as the underlying destination URL or text remains active.

Q: How do I add a logo?
A: Upload a PNG or JPG logo using the logo upload box. Error correction is automatically set to level H to ensure the code remains scannable.

Q: Can I download vector QR codes?
A: Yes. Download as a vector SVG file — perfect for print and high-resolution designs.
